verdict.rationale: Discord supports headless automation through its REST API with bot-token authentication, a Gateway WebSocket for receiving events, and webhooks that post to channels without a bot user or auth. The docs explicitly name CI/CD pipelines posting build results or deployment notifications as a webhook use case. Missing for 10: an official CLI or first-party CI integration/action, any published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
